next_external_step: No additional upload needed. Keep the SSH tunnel and game open at the current profile-2 battle; one Defend has been played, no end-turn sent. Next engineering work is controlled floor-2 scenario staging, then original adapter/dashboard and full battle validation. The floor-1 probe is excluded from the reference matrix.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until original-game behavior and declared supported scenario parity have been verified. Simulator-only tests do not prove local game parity.
limitations: Installed release v0.107.1 is bound to the received DLL through release_info commit and compatibility checksum plus full SHA-256 references/runtime match. This checks local file consistency, not a publisher signature.

One live floor-1 Defend probe passed through BridgeClient. Fixed benchmark requires floor 2; normal adapter attachment, live dashboard behavior, end-turn/reconnection, full battle and original/simulator parity remain unverified.
Comparison coverage excludes catalog-derived card values and hidden RNG; a matching finite trace never proves global game parity.
Exact original/simulator initial state and RNG alignment still require implementation and live evidence.
Reference replay checks one declared seed and refuses initial-state mismatches; no automatic original-game staging or RNG import is implemented.
